+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis"},
+		DNSNames:              []string{"redis"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, priv.Public(), priv)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return fmt.Errorf("creating Redis TLS certificate: %w", err) }
+	}
+	certPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}))
+	keyPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(priv)}))
+
+	redis := client.Container().
+		From("redis:alpine").
+		WithNewFile("/tmp/redis.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithNewFile("/tmp/redis.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: keyPEM}).
+		WithEntrypoint([]string{"redis-server"}).
+		WithDefaultArgs(dagger.ContainerWithDefaultArgsOpts{Args: []string{
+			"--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379",
+			"--tls-cert-file", "/tmp/redis.crt",
+			"--tls-key-file", "/tmp/redis.key",
+			"--tls-ca-cert-file", "/tmp/redis.crt",
+			"--tls-auth-clients", "no",
+		}}).
+		WithExposedPort(6379).
+		WithExec(nil).
+		AsService()
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithNewFile("/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH", "/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem").
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redis)
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}
+

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9a0be70
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, errors.New("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, //nolint:gosec // Explicitly requested by the operator.
+		}
+
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" || cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert := []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+			if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+				var err error
+				cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+				}
+			}
+
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, errors.New("invalid redis CA certificate: no PEM certificates found")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..438b9ee

+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"net"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) {}))
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	cert := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: server.Certificate().Raw})
+	certPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "redis-ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(certPath, cert, 0600))
+
+	base := config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: 6379, RequireTLS: true}
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		cfg        config.RedisCacheConfig
+		wantDialOK bool
+		wantErr    string
+	}{
+		{name: "system roots", cfg: base},
+		{name: "inline CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: base.Host, Port: base.Port, RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: string(cert)}, wantDialOK: true},
+		{name: "CA path", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: base.Host, Port: base.Port, RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: certPath}, wantDialOK: true},
+		{name: "skip verification", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: base.Host, Port: base.Port, RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}, wantDialOK: true},
+		{name: "conflicting CAs", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: certPath, CaCertBytes: string(cert)}, wantErr: "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{name: "missing CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.pem")}, wantErr: "reading redis CA certificate"},
+		{name: "invalid CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"}, wantErr: "invalid redis CA certificate"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tt.cfg)
+			if tt.wantErr != "" {
+				require.ErrorContains(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+				assert.Nil(t, client)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			tlsConfig := client.Options().TLSConfig
+			require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig)
+			assert.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), tlsConfig.MinVersion)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, tlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if tt.cfg.CaCertPath == "" && tt.cfg.CaCertBytes == "" {
+				assert.Nil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+			} else {
+				require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+			}
+
+			conn, err := tls.DialWithDialer(&net.Dialer{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}, "tcp", server.Listener.Addr().String(), tlsConfig)
+			if tt.wantDialOK {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				assert.NoError(t, conn.Close())
+			} else {
+				require.Error(t, err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientWithoutTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	client, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6379})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer client.Close()
+	assert.Nil(t, client.Options().TLSConfig)
+}
